This document outlines the testing procedure I1, which must be performed every 6 
months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.

The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Hesham El Sayed Mohamed El Assy, tested by eng. Mohamed Gad 
 El Rab Hawad at 17 Feb 2003, 
 reviewed by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abdel Momem El-Emam, accepted by general 
 director eng. Farouk Awad Aly, and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head Sector of 
 Talkha power plant.

Trend is a client application that allows you to query 
tags from multiple Industrial SQL Servers and plot them on a graphical display. 
Once you have added tags to a trend, you can manipulate the data in a trend 
graph in a variety of ways, including panning, zooming, and scaling. Trend graphs and 
their associated data can be printed so that the data can by analyzed away from 
the client machine. You can customize 
any trend by configuring display options, and set general options for use with 
all trends.

Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedure I1, which must be performed every 6 
months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Hesham El Sayed Mohamed El Assy, tested by eng. Mohamed Gad 
 El Rab Hawad at 17 Feb 2003, 
 reviewed by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abdel Momem El-Emam, accepted by general 
 director eng. Farouk Awad Aly, and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head Sector of 
 Talkha power plant.
Trend is a client application that allows you to query 
tags from multiple Industrial SQL Servers and plot them on a graphical display. 
Once you have added tags to a trend, you can manipulate the data in a trend 
graph in a variety of ways, including panning, zooming, and scaling. Trend graphs and 
their associated data can be printed so that the data can by analyzed away from 
the client machine. You can customize 
any trend by configuring display options, and set general options for use with 
all trends.
